title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
main_claim: Assume logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for smooth projective fibrations with reduced SNC boundaries. Then for any log canonical pair (X,Δ) on a normal compact Kähler space with K_X+Δ Q-Cartier, analytic nefness implies semiampleness. The proof is an induction through a good divisorial decomposition (G_good_n). Its key unconditional input (Thm nv:meromorphic) says that a positive power of K_X has a nonzero meromorphic section on every simple compact Kähler manifold with a(X)=0.

issues.description: Every projective case, and the projective-base program, relies on the companion preprint LI. LI is said to derive good minimal models for all projective lc pairs, which amounts to full projective log abundance and nonvanishing, from the assumption used only with zero boundaries on a resolved Albanese fibration. That is an extraordinary implication, and it is imported rather than proved here. The present paper is only as sound as LI. It is not circular, but it is an unaudited external dependency.
issues.evidence: "The good-model assertion is the rational-boundary consequence of the full argument in [LI, Prop 2.5, Thm 9.6, Sec 10] ... Its only use of Assumption is in its Lemma 6.1, on a resolved projective Albanese fibration with both boundaries zero."

issues.description: The slope inequality c1(H) <= kL for line subsheaves of the k-th tensor power of Ω_X needs three things for every class γ in the full dual of the pseudo-effective cone, possibly on its boundary: Harder–Narasimhan filtrations, semistability of tensor products (Ou Lemma 4.4), and Ou's algebraic-integrability theorem (Ou Thm 1.4). The step then uses bipolar duality to conclude pseudo-effectivity. In the Kähler setting this dual cone is not known to equal the movable cone (Kähler BDPP is open). Whether Ou's cited statements cover such γ, and not just Kähler or movable classes, is unverified here. The argument is fine if they do.
issues.evidence: "Let γ be any class in the full dual of the pseudo-effective cone ... Ou's foliation theorem [Theorem 1.4] makes this foliation the tangent foliation of a meromorphic fibration ... Separation by the dual cone proves (nv:slope-X)."

coverage: Read the intro, main theorem, the induction (Thm good-decomposition, Prop proj:good-models, end of Sec 2) and all of Section 6 (meromorphic nonvanishing on simple a(X)=0 manifolds), checking each step of Section 6. The Section 6 checks covered: (i) the slope lemma, including the H^1=0 argument, generic pointwise independence of sections from a(X)=0 and the blowup line-bundle argument; (ii) the pole-threshold lemma, where the concave tangent-line bound gives τ ≤ u0 + vol/u0^(e-1); (iii) the subvariety classification on X^2 and on Z=P(L1⊕L2), including the cycle-family meromorphic frame and the multisection coefficient quotients; (iv) the two-slot volume, with the Seshadri bounds q, (n+1)qv/2^n and d·C(2n,n)qv^2/4^n, the restriction of M_u to A_1 and the bound vol(M) ≤ Cq; (v) the direct-image lemma, with the GRR leading terms, the B_0 identity and the log-concavity ratio bound; (vi) the determinant sign calculation giving B_0 ≤ CM; (vii) the diagonal-mass selection of s, with ∫_0^{θA} Cqs^(d-1) = Cθ^d q^2 and v_E ≥ cq^2/A_q = cqA_q^(d-1); (viii) the incidence pole, with conormal sequences (a twist by +F for the strict-transform conormal), Cor slope-descent and the point bound; (ix) the coefficient-order argument in the (u,y)-adic graded ring, the monomial count H_m/N_m ≤ C(2n,n)δ^n and the maximal-minor order h_j ≥ δjRs/4; (x) the slice/axis cancellation giving cs ≤ C(2+(s+2q)/r), a contradiction. All of these steps hold up. I only skimmed the start of Section 7 (signed rigidity statement and setup) and Section 5's projective program input. Sections 3, 4, 5 and 7 (about 8k lines: programs, boundary generation, rank-one fibrations, Hodge-module lifting) were not audited in detail.
sibling_notes: Family 034 board had Uniform-Pluricanonical-Iitaka-Fibrations (rank167, no_gap, conditional on companion LA) and Conditional-good-minimal-models-for-compact-Kahler-fourfolds (rank147, no_gap; noted its projective branch rests on an unaudited appendix claiming full log abundance from Iitaka using only the D=0 Albanese case). This paper has the same dependency pattern through companion LI, which reinforces that minor flag. No shared lemma failure was reported that affects Section 6.
